data.name: Leem
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Leem means 'a garden, oasis, or paradise'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'l-m-m', which signifies 'gardens'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes a nurturing, peaceful, and prosperous environment. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, 'Paradise is a garden in which my Ummah will enter and find in it rivers, palm trees, and cool shade.' (Bukhari)
